name: Dialog
description: Modal dialog built on the native <dialog> element: top layer, inert background, focus handling and Esc for free. Centred, or a side modal (drawer, sheet) that slides in from the inline-start or inline-end edge.
whenToUse: Short focused tasks that must finish before continuing (rename, create).
Side modal: editing or inspecting a record without leaving the page, settings, filters, a mobile nav drawer.
whenNotToUse: Long forms or multi-step flows — use a page.
Non-blocking messages — use an inline notice.
A panel people keep open while they work with the page — use a layout column, not a modal.

classes.ayy-dialog: On the <dialog> element. Open with dialog.showModal().
classes.ayy-dialog--side-start: Side modal on the inline-start edge (left in LTR, right in RTL): full height, slides in. Width from the size modifiers.
classes.ayy-dialog--side-end: Side modal on the inline-end edge (right in LTR, left in RTL): full height, slides in. Width from the size modifiers.
classes.ayy-dialog__title: Heading (h2). Reference it with aria-labelledby on the dialog.
classes.ayy-dialog__body: Content that scrolls on its own, between the header and the footer. Fills the height of a side modal, so the footer sits at the bottom.
classes.ayy-dialog__footer: Actions. Stacked on mobile, right-aligned (end-aligned in RTL) from 640px.
classes.ayy-dialog__close: Icon button in the top-end corner.

js: dialogClass({ size?, side?, className? }); isBackdropClick(dialog, event); dialogCloseIcon (the Hugeicons close icon as SVG markup). Without any JS helper: dialog.showModal() / dialog.close(), or natively <button commandfor="id" command="show-modal"> in modern browsers.

attributes.persistent: Backdrop clicks don't close it (Esc still does)

element.children: A trigger with data-ayy-open and a <dialog class="ayy-dialog"> (centred or side). Inside the dialog, data-ayy-close="value" closes it and sets dialog.returnValue.

react.import: import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogBody, DialogFooter, DialogClose } from "ayywi/react";

props.side: "center" | "start" | "end" — start/end make a side modal on that inline edge
props.hideClose: boolean — hide the corner close button
props.closeLabel: string — accessible name of the close button (translate it). Default "Close"

a11y: Always include a DialogTitle (or aria-label on the dialog).
Focus moves into the dialog on open and returns to the trigger on close (native behaviour).
Esc closes; background is inert while open; page scroll is locked. A side modal is still a modal: same rules.
A body with only text that scrolls needs tabindex="0" so keyboard users can scroll it; form fields inside make that unnecessary.
Opening and closing fade/scale (side modals slide); the closing animation is skipped in browsers without @starting-style and under reduced motion.
do: Put the primary action last in the footer.
Use destructive variant for the confirm button of irreversible actions.
In a side modal, put the form fields in the body and submit from the footer with <button type="submit" form="form-id">.
dont: Don't open a dialog from inside another dialog.
Don't render DialogContent's children while closed — the React component already skips them for you.
